ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 55:45 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (>200 RGB) to low-intensity black pixels (<50 RGB) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe exhibits a dark basal pigmentation transitioning to a white distal field with vertical black striations. Right lobe is predominantly a high-intensity white field with scattered dark pixel clusters (mottling) concentrated near the medial and distal trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees with a clear vertical depth dividing the lobe segments.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform jagged peaks and valleys detected along the trailing edge; right lobe distal edge displays high-amplitude notches (10-15 pixel depth), while the left lobe displays lower-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a convex parabolic curve from the notch to the distal tips; distal tips are pointed and sweep slightly upward.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, sub-circular pixel clusters (3-8 pixels in diameter) scattered across the white field of the right lobe, consistent with remnant barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical black linear disruptions (approx. 20-40 pixels in length) visible on the white distal portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant non-congenital notch (tissue loss) observed on the far distal trailing edge of the right lobe; irregular scalloping on the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density 'salt and pepper' transition zone at the peduncle-to-fluke junction where black and white pixels intermix in a chaotic pattern.
